title: Best Friend
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig, Peppa Pig!
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸，佩奇！

lines.en: Best Friend
lines.zh: 最好的朋友

lines.en: Peppa is waiting for her best friend, Suzy Sheep.
lines.zh: 佩奇正在等待她最好的朋友小羊苏西。

lines.en: Hello Suzy! Hello Peppa!
lines.zh: 苏西你好！佩奇你好！

lines.en: Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa.
lines.zh: 小羊苏西来陪佩奇玩了。

lines.en: Peppa loves Suzy. Suzy loves Peppa. They are best friends.
lines.zh: 佩奇爱苏西。苏西爱佩奇。他们是最好的朋友。

lines.en: Peppa, why don't you and Suzy go and play in your bedroom?
lines.zh: 佩奇，你和苏西去你的卧室玩吧？

lines.en: Yes Mummy!
lines.zh: 是的妈妈！

lines.en: George wants to play too.
lines.zh: 乔治也想玩。

lines.en: Peppa and Suzy love playing in Peppa's bedroom.
lines.zh: 佩奇和苏西喜欢在佩奇的卧室里玩耍。

lines.en: So does George.
lines.zh: 乔治也是。

lines.en: No George, this game is just for big girls. Go and play with your own toys.
lines.zh: 不，乔治，这个游戏只适合大女孩。去玩你自己的玩具吧。

lines.en: Peppa and Suzy want to play on their own.
lines.zh: 佩奇和苏西想自己玩。

lines.en: I'm a tiny little fairy princess.
lines.zh: 我是一个小仙女公主。

lines.en: I'm going to wave my magic wand and turn you into a frog.
lines.zh: 我要挥舞我的魔杖，把你变成青蛙。

lines.en: George doesn't like playing on his own.
lines.zh: 乔治不喜欢一个人玩。

lines.en: George wants to play too.
lines.zh: 乔治也想玩。

lines.en: No George, I'm playing with Suzy. You have to play somewhere else.
lines.zh: 不乔治，我在和苏西玩。你必须去别的地方玩。

lines.en: George wants to play with Peppa. He feels a bit lonely.
lines.zh: 乔治想和佩奇一起玩。他感到有点孤独。

lines.en: George, I need some help. I'm making chocolate chip cookies.
lines.zh: 乔治，我需要一些帮助。我正在做巧克力饼干。

lines.en: Someone needs to lick out the bowl.
lines.zh: 有人需要把碗舔掉。

lines.en: George likes helping Mummy make cookies.
lines.zh: 乔治喜欢帮妈妈做饼干。

lines.en: But he likes playing with Peppa more.
lines.zh: 但他更喜欢和佩奇一起玩。

lines.en: I want to be a nurse. I want to be a doctor.
lines.zh: 我想成为一名护士。我想成为一名医生。

lines.en: But who's going to be the sick person?
lines.zh: 可是谁来当病人呢？

lines.en: George!
lines.zh: 乔治！

lines.en: Peppa and Suzy love playing doctors and nurses. So does George.
lines.zh: 佩奇和苏西喜欢扮演医生和护士。乔治也是如此。

lines.en: Peppa listens to George's chest.
lines.zh: 佩奇听乔治的胸腔。

lines.en: Now George, take a big breath in then cough.
lines.zh: 现在，乔治，深吸一口气，然后咳嗽。

lines.en: I think your heart's a bit loose.
lines.zh: 我觉得你的心有点松散。

lines.en: How about a plaster on it?
lines.zh: 贴个膏药怎么样？

lines.en: Open wide please.
lines.zh: 请张开。

lines.en: Suzy takes George's temperature.
lines.zh: 苏西测量乔治的体温。

lines.en: Oh dear, you're very very hot. I think you have to stay in bed for three years.
lines.zh: 哦亲爱的，你非常非常热辣。我认为你必须在床上躺三年。

lines.en: Daddy Pig has come to find George.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸来找乔治了。

lines.en: Oh no, what's wrong with George?
lines.zh: 哦不，乔治怎么了？

lines.en: Don't worry Daddy, it's only a game. George is our patient.
lines.zh: 别担心爸爸，这只是一个游戏。乔治是我们的病人。

lines.en: Oh I see. Can the patient have a visitor?
lines.zh: 哦，我明白了。病人可以接待探视者吗？

lines.en: Just for a little while. He might get tired.
lines.zh: 就一会儿。他可能会累。

lines.en: Cookies!
lines.zh: 饼干！

lines.en: Yes, they're for George. They're his medicine to make him feel better.
lines.zh: 是的，它们是给乔治的。它们是让他感觉好一点的良药。

lines.en: Excuse me Doctor, can you help me? I have a sore tummy.
lines.zh: 请问医生，你能帮我吗？我肚子疼。

lines.en: That tickles.
lines.zh: 好痒。

lines.en: I can hear him rumbling. I think you're hungry Daddy.
lines.zh: 我能听到他的隆隆声。我觉得爸爸你饿了。

lines.en: Then I think I need lots of cookies to make me better.
lines.zh: 那么我想我需要很多饼干来让我变得更好。

lines.en: And me!
lines.zh: 还有我！

lines.en: And me!
lines.zh: 还有我！

lines.en: And me!
lines.zh: 还有我！
